coverage_gate.applies_to: every quarterly decision in the tested window
coverage_gate.if_unmet: the affected decisions are excluded and the exclusion is reported, rather than the bar being lowered again

known_limitations: 85 issuers cannot be priced from any source available here and are the adverse scenario's entire subject
coverage decays going backwards, so the earliest years lean hardest on the adverse assumption
the ETF-family strategies are not included; this protocol covers the SEC single-name families only
promotion_authority: none. This protocol measures and never authorises trading.

promotion_gate.binding: failure under adverse is a rejection. The adverse scenario may not be weakened, reinterpreted, or replaced after seeing a result.
promotion_gate.requirement: a strategy must beat its declared benchmark under BOTH scenarios, at 50bps, across the full tested window and in each regime window separately

purpose: Test strategies that are already frozen against 2012-2022, a period none of them has ever seen. Because the strategies are fixed, this consumes no new trials; nothing is being searched, only measured.
revision_policy: Any change to the coverage bar, either scenario, or the promotion gate creates v2 and marks this version superseded.

scenarios.adverse: an issuer with no validated price is held at its intended weight and assigned a -100% return over the holding period
scenarios.base: an issuer with no validated price is excluded from the book and its intended weight is held in cash earning zero

trial_accounting: zero new trials. Every strategy here was frozen before this protocol was written and no parameter is searched. Any parameter varied later is a new trial and must be declared in a v2.

why_the_coverage_bar_moved_and_what_that.decision: bar lowered to 90% minimum decision-row coverage, paired with a binding adverse scenario
why_the_coverage_bar_moved_and_what_that.honest_characterisation: This is a threshold relaxed after watching it fail, which is the move this project exists to resist. It is defensible only because the adverse scenario below is genuinely punishing and is declared before the backtest rather than after. If the adverse result is bad, that is the answer and it will not be relitigated by loosening the scenario.
why_the_coverage_bar_moved_and_what_that.measured_ceiling: 89.9% minimum annual coverage, 21 of 58 decisions clearing 95%, with 85 issuers permanently unpriced
why_the_coverage_bar_moved_and_what_that.original_bar: 95% of decision rows priced at every decision, declared 2026-09-05 before any coverage number existed

written_before: any strategy has been run against any pre-2023 data, and before the Tiingo recovery batches finished
